# PolicyHandle

Kind: context · Defined in [`src/onnx/policy_runner.h`](../../../src/onnx/policy_runner.h) · Described in `data/world.json`

World context variable: the ONNX policy the world's Policy system runs on its AgentIO.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `runner` | `std::shared_ptr<PolicyRunner>` | for an agent with one vector observation and continuous actions |
| `deterministic` | `bool` | the mean action (true) or mean + noise |
| `agent` | `std::shared_ptr<AgentPolicy>` | for an agent with sensors or discrete branches; used instead of `runner` when set |

## Notes

Injected by ModelWatcher (viewer), TrainHost (mode=eval) or tests with insert_or_assign; replacing it swaps the policy at the next decision. makePolicyHandle picks runner or agent from an AgentIO's layout. Sessions are shared between worlds.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: —. Written by: ModelWatcher, Policy, TrainHost. Created by: ModelWatcher, TrainHost. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [ModelWatcher](../systems/ModelWatcher.md) | system | Host | **write+create** | tick (load) | insert_or_assign into the registry of every world of the feed: the Policy system there runs it from its next decision |
| [Policy](../systems/Policy.md) | system | World | **readwrite** | tick | the runner or agent policy run; an AgentPolicy that throws is dropped (agent reset) |
| [TrainHost](../systems/service-TrainHost.md) | service | World | **write+create** | eval, evalAnimals | the eval's policy (var.model) in every world, deterministic unless var.stochastic |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[ModelWatcher](../systems/ModelWatcher.md)**
  - Reads the file system: lists <dir> (or the directories matching a '*' component) for <behavior>-<step>.onnx every `poll` seconds of wall clock; a new checkpoint is loaded once two polls see the same size and write time.
  - Creates ONNX Runtime sessions (PolicyRunner, or AgentPolicy through a process-wide cache keyed by path and write time).
  - Logs info on every load, a warning when a folder has no checkpoint, an error when a model is refused.
- **[Policy](../systems/Policy.md)**
  - ONNX Runtime inference on the CPU, on the worker that steps the world.
  - Logs an error and drops the AgentPolicy when its layout does not match the agent.
- **[TrainHost](../systems/service-TrainHost.md)**
  - gRPC client of the ML-Agents trainer (MlAgentsClient on localhost:<port>); reads the environment parameters and engine configuration side channels.
  - Files: envparams.txt (-envParamsOut, written on change), .demo (record-demo), eval summaries (var.out), replays (<prefix>.track.*, .replay.*, .sandbox.*, .grass.bin), legs CSV, cot_out, demo checks JSON.
  - tf::Executor workers for bench, eval and the worlds' steps.
  - Restarts the worlds with the trainer's seed (ScenarioRunner::restart) when the trainer connects in mode=train.
  - Logs the mode's progress and summaries; exit codes 0 (QUIT, stop signal), 1 (bad arguments), 2 (connection lost).
